productCerts.description: Certified food production facility meeting Indian food safety standards. License covers processing, packaging, and export of dehydrated foods.

productCerts.title: ISO 9001:2015
productCerts.description: International quality management system certification. Ensures consistent product quality, documentation, and continuous improvement practices.

productCerts.title: HACCP Certified
productCerts.fullName: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points
productCerts.description: Systematic approach to food safety identifying critical control points in production. Ensures hazards are identified and controlled at every stage.

productCerts.title: GMP Certified
productCerts.description: Good Manufacturing Practice certification ensuring our facility meets international standards for equipment, personnel, and processes.

productCerts.title: Organic Certification
productCerts.description: Certification for organic dehydrated vegetables and spices. Certifies products are produced without synthetic pesticides or GMOs.

productCerts.title: Spices Board India
productCerts.description: Official approval from India's Spices Board for export of spices and spice products. Required for international trade in spice category.

exportCerts.title: Certificate of Origin
exportCerts.description: Official documentation proving the country of origin of products. Required by customs in most importing countries for tariff classification.

exportCerts.title: Phytosanitary Certificate
exportCerts.description: Certificate confirming plant material is free from specified pests and diseases. Mandatory for agricultural products moving internationally.

exportCerts.title: Health Certificate
exportCerts.description: Health authority certification that food products are safe for human consumption and free from contamination.

exportCerts.title: Free Trade Agreement
exportCerts.description: Certification enabling eligibility under bilateral/multilateral free trade agreements for preferential tariff rates.

exportCerts.title: Test Reports
exportCerts.description: Comprehensive laboratory testing confirming product specifications, nutritional values, and absence of contaminants.

exportCerts.title: Export License
exportCerts.description: Official export license from Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority enabling international food trade.
